summary: The parser rejected negative zero offsets (-00:00, -0000, and -00), returning TimestampError::ParseFailure. Removing the sign-dependent guard accepts these offsets as zero while preserving hour/minute bounds. The verbatim reversal is uniquely matched and restores the parent implementation exactly. Blocked: no detecting upstream test was found at the fixed commit. The fix adds no tests; datetime::tests::test_parse_timestamp omits negative zero offsets, and the timestamp formatting roundtrip property generates Z offsets only. No builds or tests were run.
